name: BvS 10 Viking
representative_system: BvS 10 Viking — Tracked all-terrain armored carrier
characteristics: Strength: Articulated tracked design gives strong cross-country/soft-ground mobility unusual among donated APCs
Limitation: Niche platform originally designed for Arctic/soft-terrain use, not purpose-built for the mixed terrain of the Ukrainian front
Estimated quantity available: Donated numbers not fully disclosed
employment_notes: One of the less common donated APC types, valued for mobility in wet/muddy conditions that immobilize wheeled vehicles
contrast_vs_traditional: The Viking's articulated, all-terrain hull exists to move across ground that has no road at all — originally an Arctic and amphibious design case. That happens to be a direct answer to the problem facing wheeled vehicles on this front: predictable road movement is exactly what persistent drone ISR watches for, so a carrier that never needed the road in the first place sidesteps that vulnerability rather than having to out-drive it.

sources.label: Army Recognition — Netherlands delivers BvS-10 Viking to Ukraine
